name: Zoolz
description_en:
Zoolz Business combines cloud file backup with Hot and Cold Storage allocations and administrative policies. Cold storage is an archive-oriented recovery path, so the homepage’s broad instant-access wording should not be applied to every stored file.

The current plan family is not evidence that historical Zoolz Home offers or BigMIND features apply to this service. This profile follows a selected file into cold backup and recovery and distinguishes subscription capacity from retrieval behavior. No application, account or recovery was tested.
description_zh:
Zoolz Business 结合云文件备份、Hot／Cold Storage 配额和管理策略。冷存储是归档型恢复路径，不能把首页笼统的即时访问措辞用于每个文件。

当前套餐不能证明历史 Zoolz Home 报价或 BigMIND 功能适用于本服务。本文跟踪所选文件的冷备份和恢复，区分订阅容量与取回行为，未测试应用、账户或恢复。

sections.title_en: Assign files to the intended tier
sections.title_zh: 把文件分配到预期层级
sections.en:
The official wiki describes selecting files under the desktop Cold Storage tab or through a Business administrator’s policy. If a file is selected for both Hot and Cold, Hot takes priority rather than creating two independent copies.

For example, assign inactive project documents to Cold and a frequently needed working set to Hot. Verify where each appears in the console before deleting or moving originals. The choice should follow recovery needs, not simply unused aggregate capacity.
sections.zh:
官方 wiki 说明可通过桌面 Cold Storage 页或 Business 管理员策略选择文件；同时选 Hot 和 Cold 时，Hot 优先，并非生成两个独立副本。

例如，可将不活跃项目文档分到 Cold，常用工作集分到 Hot。删除或移动原件前，先确认各自在控制台的位置。层级应按恢复需求决定，不能只看总容量剩余。

sections.title_en: Cold recovery starts after a wait
sections.en:
The restore guide describes selecting a source computer, files and restore options in Zoolz Restore. It says Cold retrieval requires 3–12 hours to commence and asks users to keep the computer running without sleep or logout. Its web method imposes a 1-GB-per-day Cold download quota; larger restores should use the desktop application.

The separate Cold product page quotes 3–5 hours, a narrower window than the guide. Keep that discrepancy visible and confirm the current service conditions. Neither value measures complete download time. Test the exact file set and destination before relying on an emergency restore.
sections.zh:
恢复指南说明在 Zoolz Restore 中选择来源电脑、文件及恢复选项；Cold 取回需 3–12 小时才开始，并要求电脑持续运行，不休眠或注销。网页方式对 Cold 下载设每日 1 GB 额度，更大恢复应使用桌面应用。

另一个 Cold 产品页写 3–5 小时，比指南窗口更窄，应保留差异并确认当前服务条件。两种数字均不是完整下载耗时，依赖紧急恢复前需测试准确文件集和目标。

sections.title_en: Price the hot/cold split and account limits
sections.title_zh: 按冷热比例及账户限制理解价格
sections.en:
The retrieved annual plan page lists USD 199.99 for 2.5 TB split into 2 TB Cold and 500 GB Hot, with five users, one server and a 20-GB upload-file limit. The 7-TB offer is USD 599.99 yearly, split into 6 TB Cold and 1 TB Hot, with different user/server/file allowances. A 14-day trial is advertised.

Do not compare these as interchangeable terabytes of immediate-access storage. Larger tiers, discounts, renewal and final taxes require the actual selected offer. “Unlimited users and servers” in general promotional text does not override the entry plan’s explicit five-user/one-server caps.
sections.zh:
读取的年付套餐列 2.5 TB 每年 199.99 美元，分为 2 TB Cold 和 500 GB Hot，限五用户、一服务器、单上传文件 20 GB；7 TB 每年 599.99 美元，分为 6 TB Cold 和 1 TB Hot，用户／服务器／文件额度不同，并宣传 14 天试用。

不能将这些容量当成同样可即时访问的 TB 比较。更大套餐、优惠、续费及最终税费需按所选报价核对。通用宣传中的“不限用户和服务器”不能覆盖入门套餐明确的五用户／一服务器限制。

sections.title_en: Use a recovery objective to choose archive storage
sections.title_zh: 按恢复目标选择归档存储
sections.en:
Shortlist Zoolz for supported business file protection where archive delay is acceptable and the Hot allocation fits urgent recovery needs. A workflow requiring every file immediately available needs a different tier allocation or further evaluation.

Prepare supported clients, source access, backup policies and a receiving device, then verify a completed backup and representative restore. Inspect failed or missing files instead of relying on capacity purchased. Exact retention/version defaults, full license contract, current client/OS compatibility, data region and detailed failure escalation were not confirmed; no security or recovery-speed claim was independently measured.
sections.zh:
归档等待可接受，且 Hot 配额满足紧急恢复时，可考虑 Zoolz 用于受支持商业文件保护。要求所有文件即时可用的流程，需要不同层级分配或进一步评估。

需准备受支持客户端、来源访问、策略和接收设备，再验证备份完成及代表性恢复；检查失败或缺失文件，不能只看已购容量。准确版本保留默认值、完整许可、当前客户端／OS 兼容性、数据区域及详细故障升级未确认，未独立测量安全或恢复速度。
